About

Curio Magazine is an independent Lifestyle & Events publication with an interest in London, established in January 2015. We provide considered content that aims to complement the reader. We target distinct, affluent audiences and new, up-and-coming London socialites rather than catering to a blind mass.

Print Run:  Curio had a limited run in print in the UK and United States for two years at its inception and has been granted a further one-year print exclusively for London. Curio now appears online in digital format and will likely remain a digital publication. Markets:  We directly market to key decision makers: executives, celebrities and patrons with our print editions. These are then distributed to upscale retailers, restaurants, boutiques, perfumeries, supermarkets, hairdressers, private medical practices, and more.

Structure

Digital:  Our digital publication includes an interactive digital flip book downloadable onto tablets and smartphones for viewing.  These can be read on our website: http://www.curiomagazine.co.uk/ and well as other social media platforms.

Print:  The limited print versions were published as a full-colour, high-gloss, B4 size magazine. In showcasing London, we feature intriguing and timely events based in London, local business, museum exhibitions, beauty, film & music, culture, dining, entertainment, fashion, health & wellness, environment, sporting events, nightlife, philanthropy, charity galas, politics, real estate and advertising.

Audience and Parent:  Curio is read by London locals, nationally and a growing American audience. Curio Magazine is a publication of Pinewood & Associates Global Consultation & Development Services, Inc.

Strategy - Analysis

Strategy Change:  Last decade, the magazine business was profitable if one could identify the right gap in the market. Selling regular printed copies and ad pages was our bread and butter. Now, in 2019, our circulation has fallen to just 2,500 copies a year. Much of our lifestyle section content has been upstaged by rival social media platforms. Fortunately, our focus has always been on events and culture rather than fashion – which has lost much less revenue than fashion by the digital transformation taking place in the business.

Blog:  In a bid to generate further interest, in January 2016 Curio launched a new blog—the Sunday Curio Blog. Each Sunday morning the editors of Curio magazine recommend one event or occurrence for readers' weekend plans.

Strategy - Overview

Revenue:  We have shifted market attention to: events, e-commerce, e-learning, and digital print, in an attempt to generate new revenue streams. The relationship with our readers is important, less the medium itself. Though page yield is down, and sales are falling, cutting our outgoing cost through savings has meant that profits in 2019 are higher than they were in 2016.

Podcast: In fitting with a shift in average content consumption behaviour, Curio are launching a weekly podcast on Fridays starting in January 2019. The aim is to discuss London-centric news and deliver any limited-run events going on or things we feel customers should find intriguing. Given the importance of adverts for our strategy, the podcast will be three-minute slots for adverts every twelve minutes.

Business - Models

Subscription Service:  A common model for magazine business is to apply a subscription service. Curio Magazine does not use a full-scale subscription model as there would not be enough added value and we would have too few subscribers to make it work.

Freemium:  The freemium business model offers part free content but requires payment to access all content. Curio Magazine finds this model effectively in conjunction with an adequate part-sized subscription service, and as such the most reasonable solution. Therefore, we have a premium paid service which gives our members free access to our events as well as discount coupons to various opportunities we advertise. This service is a monthly cost of £5.00 and all online content is available free of charge to all users regardless of being a member or not.

Business - Innovation

Adverts:  Given our business model, adverts will be the lifeblood of our business. Not only will our magazine hold much space for advertisements, we will actively promote events in London at a fee for those that ask for it. Our online ads typically revolve around new, shiny digital products as they give us the biggest investment (though unfortunately show us little return).

Innovation and Flexibility:  Regardless of the reduction in our traditional revenue stream, it has never been easier to publish our magazine – in digital form, or in its limited glorious printed incarnation. Nevertheless, it has equally never been harder to build a robust business model around publishing great magazines – given the costs required for hiring reliable, talented, and experience individuals able to produce the standard of quality content we desire. As such, at Curio Magazine our solution is to innovate and experiment.

Sushi A

A new, tiny sushi restaurant is opening on Theobalds Rd in Holborn – Nimue Sushi.

Nimue Sushi is compact but perfect in form.

Sushi has always been known for eaten in bitesize pieces, always presented in a considered set. The phrase: ‘Good things come in small packages’ comes to mind. While Nimue Sushi may be a small restaurant, it will certainly serve you sushi with some of the biggest flavours in London. Nimue Sushi is indeed small. It only has space for twelve diners at any one time, making it quite an exclusive affair, especially as it increases in popularity. Their public relations officer told us that they were booked up until April 2019 at the earliest. They have a difficult booking system. Their phones are open Monday where you must call to make reservation for the following week. Remember, they don’t accept walk ins.

Sushi B

Once you get a seat, Chef Toshio Suzuki will treat you to a luscious display of nigiri, uramaki and maki sushi rolls. Whether from salmon, tuna, shrimp, crab or egg, each piece of sushi is tenderly placed on your plate by the Chef. As such, you have no control over what you order, which may unsettle some, but rest assured you’ll know each piece you get will have the high-quality standard the Chef strives for. The set menu will cost £50, and extra for any desired drinks. All you need to do now is make that reservation call.

Location: 29 Theobalds Road, Holborn, WC1X 8SP. Nearest station is Holborn or Chancery Lane. Opening hours: 6:00-10.30pm (Tue to Sat), closed Sunday and Monday. All bookings are for two hours of dining. Price: Two pieces of nigiri starts at £9, two uramaki at £6 and two maki at £3.

questions.t: Curio Magazine implements an online subscription service for revenue purposes.
questions.e: False - In the Business - Models tab, it states that Curio Magazine does not use a subscription service given that it would not be a valuable mechanism to use. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Curio Magazine was printing in the United States during 2018.
questions.e: False - In the About tab, it states that Curio Magazine was established in January 2015. In the Print Run section, it states that the print run was for two years in the United States, and no further. This means that it ended in 2017. Therefore, it was not printing in the United States during 2018. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: At Nimue Sushi, a bottle of sake wine is cheaper than two pieces of nigiri sushi.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Sushi B tab, while we know the price of two pieces of nigiri sushi (£9), we do not know the price of sake. It is not stated. Therefore, we have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: In 2018, the printed circulation was higher than in 2019.
questions.e: Cannot Say - While in the Strategy - Analysis tab it states that in 2019 the circulation has fallen inferring that the circulation figure of 2018 was indeed higher, it is not stated as a demonstrable fact anywhere else. We can certainly strongly infer, but it is not demonstrably true. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: If paid to, Curio Magazine will actively promote events in London.
questions.e: True - In the Business - Innovation tab, it states that Curio will actively promote events in London for a fee. Therefore, this is demonstrably true. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: In 2016, Prints of Curio were distributed as A4 size magazines in the UK.
questions.e: False - In the Structure tab, it states that the print distribution was in B4 size, not in A4. The print run was also in the UK, so while that rings true, meaning that it is not a cannot say, the print size is wrong. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Curio Magazine can be viewed from a tablet or smartphone device.
questions.e: True - In the Structure tab, it states that the magazine can be downloaded onto tablet or smartphone for viewing. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Curio magazine publishes articles about politics.
questions.e: True – In the Structure tab, it states that Curio feature a number of events in London that includes the subject of ‘politics.’ Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: The Curio blog is published on a Monday.
questions.e: False - In the Strategy - Analysis tab, it states that the blog is published on a Sunday, hence its title, the ‘Sunday Curio Blog.’ Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: The majority of Curio Magazine’s audience are affluent, up-and-coming London socialites.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the About tab, while it states that ‘affluent, up-and-coming socialites’ are its target audience, there is no indication that this is indeed the majority of its audience. We have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Some online content at Curio is only available for those on their premium paid subscription service.
questions.e: False - In the Business - Models tab, it states that anyone on the premium paid subscription service would not have any extra content as ‘all online content is available free of charge to all users regardless of being a member or not.’ Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Curio Magazine feature events based on motor-racing in London.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Structure tab, it states that Curio feature “intriguing and timely events based in London” such as culture or charity galas. However, while there is no mention of motor-racing, it says ‘etc’, therefore implying that it could be about any number of different subjects. Since the passage does not explicitly state that there is demonstrably not motor-racing, we have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: In 2016, profits at Curio were lower than they in 2019.
questions.e: True - In the Strategy - Overview tab, it states that even though page yield and sales are down, profits are higher in 2019 than they were in 2016. Therefore, it is demonstrable that it is so. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Shiny digital products give Curio Magazine the biggest return on their investment for online ads.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Business - Innovation tab, it states that while shiny digital products give them the biggest investment, the return on that investment is not that high. Even with this being the case, there is no other online ad group to compare this to in order to test whether it gives Curio the biggest return on their investment for online ads or not. We have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Printed versions of Curio Magazine are marketed to celebrities.
questions.e: True - In the About tab, it states that the print editions are directly marketed to celebrities. Therefore, this statement is demonstrable. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: According to the Curio magazine article, Nimue Sushi is opposite a competing Asian restaurant.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Sushi A and B tab, it states that Nimue Sushi is located on Theobalds Road in Holborn. However, it does not state what it next to it, nor what is opposite it – Asian restaurant or no. Therefore, we have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: The best way to get a table at Nimue Sushi is to turn up early and walk in.
questions.e: False - In the Sushi A tab, while being prompt will no doubt help with getting into a rather exclusive restaurant, it states that Nimue Sushi do not accept walk ins. Therefore, this is demonstrably false. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Rival social media platforms have displaced or outshone much of Curio Magazine’s lifestyle section content.
questions.e: True - In the Strategy - Analysis tab, it states that much of the lifestyle content has been upstaged by rival social media platforms. Therefore, this is demonstrably true. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: The Curio Magazine podcast runs on Friday in order to recommend listeners things to do for the weekend in London.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Strategy - Overview tab, it states that the Curio Magazine podcast will indeed run on the Friday. The explanation for why this might be in the question statement is entirely likely. However, there is no indication or demonstrable statement of this in the passages. Therefore, there is insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Curio Magazine feature events based on charity galas in London.
questions.e: True - In the Structure tab, it states that Curio feature “intriguing and timely events based in London” such as ‘charity galas’. Therefore, this is demonstrable from the passage. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: When the Curio Magazine podcast first launches, you would be able to reserve a place at Nimue Sushi.
questions.e: False - In the Sushi A tab, it states to reserve a table, you have to call up on the Monday for the following week or the following month. It states that they are booked up until the end of March. Assuming booking by month gaps, this would mean that it would need to be March to book beyond that. In the Strategy - Overview tab, it states that the Curio podcast will launch on January 2019. If you were to book when the podcast first launches, the latest booking could be made on the February. But as stated, Nimue Sushi is booked up until March. Therefore, you would not be able to reserve a place at Nimue Sushi when the Curio podcast first launches. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: According to Curio Magazine, it is easier to build a secure business model around publishing magazines.
questions.e: False - In the Business - Innovation tab, in the Innovation and Flexibility section, it states that Curio magazine believe that it has never been harder to build a robust business model around publishing magazines. Therefore, this is demonstrable false. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Pinewood & Associates Global Consultation & Development Services, Inc is the publisher of Curio Magazine.
questions.e: True - In the Structure tab, it states that Curio Magazine is published by Pinewood & Associates Global Consultation & Development Services, Inc. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Chef Toshio Suzuki serves more uramaki sushi rolls than nigiri.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Sushi B tab, it states the Chef Toshio Suzuki serves nigiri, uramaki and maki sushi rolls. However, it also states that “you have no control over what you order” so there is no information about whether Chef Toshio Suzuki serves more uramaki sushi rolls more not. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Curio Magazine uses the freemium business model.
questions.e: True - In the Business - Models tab, it states that “the freemium business model offers part free content but requires payment to access all or additional content”. However, it states that for Curio Magazine, while it has a premium paid service that could fit this description, “all online content is available free of charge to all users”. Therefore, while all content is free already, additional content is offered only to premium members, i.e. discount coupons. Therefore, Curio Magazine uses the freemium business model as defined in the passage. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Curio Magazine employs very few individuals.
questions.e: Cannot Say - While in the Business - Innovation tab it mentions the need for talented individuals, there is no indication of how many employees work at Curio Magazine. There is insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: A 12-month, annual membership to the premium paid service at Curio Magazine would cost less than the set menu at Nimue Sushi.
questions.e: False - In the Sushi B tab, it states that the set menu costs £50. In the Business -Models tab, it states that the premium service costs £5 a month – therefore, it will cost £60 for 12 months. The set menu therefore costs less than a year of the premium service, not less. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Curio Magazine has had a reduction in its ‘traditional’ revenue stream.
questions.e: True - While no actual figures are available in the passage, in the Business -Innovation tab, it states that they have suffered a reduction in their traditional revenue stream. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: In 2016, Curio Magazine made most of their revenue by printed copies and advertisement pages.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Strategy - Analysis tab, it states that selling printed copies and ad pages was the main source of revenue. However, this is stated not for Curio Magazine in particular, but more generally for the magazine business. There is no indication demonstrably that it was Curio’s traditional revenue stream in 2016 – even if it can be implied or assumed. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: As the magazine business transforms to digital, events and culture have suffered from a greater loss of revenue than fashion.
questions.e: False - In the Strategy - Analysis tab, it states that events and culture have NOT lost as much revenue than fashion – which has lost more than events and culture from the digital transformation taking place in the magazine business. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Printed versions of Curio Magazine are distributed to bank branches.
questions.e: Cannot say - In the About tab, it states that Curio Magazine is distributed to retailers, restaurants and ‘more’. This means that it is entirely possible that Curio is marketed to bank branches, but it is not demonstrable, unlike, say, restaurants. We have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: The Curio Magazine digital flip book is available on their website.
questions.e: True - In the Structure tab, it states that the digital flip book can be read on ‘our’ (meaning the Curio Magazine) website. Therefore, this is demonstrably the case. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Curio Magazine has an audience in the United States.
questions.e: True - While in the About tab, it states that Curio had a print run in the United States, this does not mean there was an audience. In the Structure tab, it states that Curio is read by London locals, but has a growing American audience – therefore, it is demonstrable in the passage. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: Printed versions of Curio Magazine are marketed to officials.
questions.e: False - In the About tab, it states that printed Curio is directly marketed to executives, celebrities and patrons. Therefore, it is not marketed to officials. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: At Nimue Sushi, the set menu costs more than the combined price of 6 pieces of nigiri sushi and 6 pieces of uramaki sushi.
questions.e: False - In the Sushi B tab, it states that the set menu price if £50. It also says that 2 pieces of nigiri sushi is £9, and 2 pieces of uramaki sushi is £6. Therefore, 6 pieces of nigiri would be £27, and 6 pieces of uramaki would be £18. A combined price of £45. This would be less that the set menu of £50, not more. Thus the correct answer is false.

questions.t: Curio Magazine uses e-learning as a market avenue for generating new revenue streams.
questions.e: True - In the Strategy - Overview tab, it states that Curio use “e-learning” as an attempt to generate new revenue streams. Therefore, this is demonstrable in the passage. Thus the correct answer is true.

questions.t: The Curio podcast will have at least ten-minutes of adverts for each episode.
questions.e: Cannot Say - In the Strategy - Overview tab, it states that the podcast will have three-minute slots for adverts every twelve minutes. However, this does not give us as indication of how long adverts will be overall in an episode given that we do not know the minimum length of any given episode. We have insufficient information. Thus the correct answer is cannot say.

questions.t: Nimue Sushi can only serve fourteen customers at any one time.
questions.e: False - In the Sushi A tab, it states that Nimue Sushi is a small restaurant and “only has space for twelve diners” – therefore, not fourteen. Thus the correct answer is false.
